text: Hold SUPPORT. A 1.40 day_vol floor is not in my method: volume enters it only as liquidity (C25) and fund flow (C28), and subcomponents.flow.cmf is unserved here, so I cannot confirm or refute flow. My buy signal is the resistance break itself (C26): D dist_to_20bar_high_pct 0.13, D last_bar green, W ema_order 9>21. Trigger I stand behind: trade_above:bar_high, a buy stop one tick over yesterday's high, trailed daily (C27). I do not need the volume test; I would not object if it is written in as oneil's. Wrong if a daily close below max(fib_swing_low, base_low_20d) or structure_shift_ref.
